error.title: Document exceeds the publishing size limits
error.description:
### Document is too large {msg}
A document cannot be published reliably when:
- a side is **{max_dimension} px** or more, which cannot be saved as PSD (it is saved as PSB instead) - it has more than **{max_pixels} px** in total, which can fail review and thumbnail extraction and produce multi-GB staging files
### How to work around it This validation is **optional**. If you still need to publish this document, disable **Validate Document Size** in the publisher's plugin list (or in `ayon+settings://photoshop/publish/ValidateDocumentSize`).
